**BLUF:** In Tazewell County, Virginia, the main development is the rescheduling of a Tazewell Circuit Court hearing on a challenge to Virginia’s recently approved constitutional amendment on reproductive rights, now set for November 24 before retiring Judge Hurley. Across the state line in Mercer County, West Virginia, local governments marked Veterans Day with parades and proclamations while state officials discussed Medicaid work requirements affecting thousands of recipients. No active NWS alerts, major incidents, or road closures reported in the core area as of midday Friday.[[1]](https://x.com/TFFVA/status/2118404773787361757)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours for Tazewell County Sheriff’s Office, local police departments, Mercer County Sheriff, or Virginia/West Virginia State Police in the core area. No arrests, seizures, or court outcomes noted in recent local coverage.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours. No active NWS alerts for the core area. No VDOT or WVDOH closures noted on US-19, US-460, US-52, Route 16, Route 67, or I-77.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Tazewell County, Virginia:** Tazewell County Circuit Court hearing on a legal challenge to Virginia’s Ballot Question 1 (abortion amendment) was rescheduled from November 13 to November 24 due to a scheduling conflict with Judge Hurley, who is set to retire but will still rule on the matter. The Founding Freedoms Law Center seeks a preliminary injunction to block certification of results.[[1]](https://x.com/TFFVA/status/2118404773787361757)

A Virginia delegate will oversee the judicial selection process for the upcoming Tazewell County vacancy created by the retirement.[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/p/Republican-Party-of-Tazewell-County-VA-61567324614575/?locale=en_GB)

**Mercer County, West Virginia:** Oakvale received two proclamations from the Mercer County Commission.

West Virginia state estimates indicate 40,000 Medicaid recipients are not meeting work requirements.

West Virginia members of Congress declined to comment on working with Democrats to reverse Medicaid cuts.[[1]](https://x.com/TFFVA/status/2118404773787361757)

**Region:** Nothing additional reported in the last 24 hours for state actions directly impacting the broader area.

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Bluefield, West Virginia (Mercer County):** The city received federal Opportunity Zone designation covering the city and areas near Kee Dam, aimed at spurring investment, including potential ATV-related development.[[3]](https://www.bdtonline.com/news/local_news/city-economic-growth-gets-boost/article_87c6ccb6-9e79-47e4-9dd0-8d1a3e83f4c0.html)

**Tazewell, Virginia:** Tazewell Today announced holiday events including a Veterans Parade on November 8, bingo on November 15, and the T-Town Turkey Trot on November 26.[[4]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-today-announces-their-holiday-event-lineup-to-close-out-2026/)

**Region:** Nothing additional reported in the last 24 hours for major employers, mines, hospitals, or energy developments.

- November 15: Bingo with Tazewell Today at Nuckolls Hall, Tazewell, VA.[[4]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-today-announces-their-holiday-event-lineup-to-close-out-2026/)
- November 24: Rescheduled Tazewell Circuit Court hearing on constitutional amendment challenge.[[1]](https://x.com/TFFVA/status/2118404773787361757)
